# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile. An Agent Profile defines the execution role, account/region scope (via aggregation configuration access roles), and Well-Architected pillar focus used to generate Well-Architected Agent recommendations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation_configuration` (Attributes Set) The aggregation configuration entries (account, regions, access role) associated with this profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregation_configuration))
- `execution_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role assumed to execute recommendation actions.
- `name` (String) The name of the profile. Unique within the account and used as the last component of the ARN.
- `pillars` (Set of String) The list of Well-Architected pillars to focus on.

### Optional

- `business_overview` (String) A business overview for the profile used to improve recommendation quality.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether deletion protection is enabled for the profile. When enabled, the profile cannot be deleted until deletion protection is disabled.
- `description` (String) A description of the profile.
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name of the profile.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Key-value pairs to associate with the Agent Profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Profile.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the profile was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that created this profile.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The timestamp when the profile was last modified.
- `last_modified_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that last modified this profile.

<a id="nestedatt--aggregation_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregation_configuration`

Required:

- `access_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role used to access resources in this account.
- `account_id` (String) The target AWS account ID.
- `regions` (Set of String) The target regions in the account.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Profile

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile.example "arn"
```
